comingLast.roast: all square with Thomas at the bottom - somebody has to blink (or wipe)
tied for last with Smyth - one of them buys, both of them stay
level with Smyth at the bottom - the blue balls may need a countback
in the clubhouse 1 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
finished with a 4-point buffer - his group is still reminding him hourly
safe-ish by 5 - the blue balls have come back from further
done, 5 clear, and suddenly an expert on everyone else's back nine
in on a cushion of 5 - refreshing the board between sips
in the clubhouse 6 above Smyth - cheering for him from a safe distance
